description: Left behind by his eleven brothers, Ash-Lad sits crying in the long grass by the road, until a tussock in front of him begins to stir. A Norwegian fairy tale about a very small bride, told in lively modern English.
summary: Ash-Lad’s brothers leave him behind, but by the roadside he meets a girl no taller than his hand, who sews a shirt in a single day and becomes his bride.
